capabilities: add selected editor or reading-view text as a Dida365/TickTick task
prompt for a task list and an optional reason before creating
clean decorative symbols like 《》 from task titles
append the source note link ([[note path]]) to the task description
reuse DidaSync's OAuth connection instead of managing tokens itself
extras: Manual/development install only (copy main.js and manifest.json into the plugin folder and enable); README is written in Chinese; contact email divaliu1408@qq.com; task creation happens in TickTick, not inside the vault.
intentEvidence: 复用 DidaSync 插件的连接与同步管线（app.plugins.plugins["didasync"]），不自行管理 OAuth/token
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to push a selected passage into TickTick as a task, and DidaSync alone does not create tasks from note selections.
